The '''2012–13 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Arkansas]] in the [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2012–13]] [[college basketball]] season. The team's [[head coach]] is [[Mike Anderson (basketball, born 1959)|Mike Anderson]], who completed his second season at Arkansas after posting an 18–14 record during the 2011–12 season, where the Razorbacks finished ninth in the SEC. Arkansas finished seventh in the SEC, but a 1–12 record away from the state of Arkansas kept it from participating in the postseason. The team played their home games at [[Bud Walton Arena]] in [[Fayetteville, Arkansas]], as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference|SEC]].
